body: On Wednesday, March 18, 2025, from 0200 until 0400, DTI will be upgrading the DTI-managed DNS servers.
The State of Delaware Data Center will be undergoing a power upgrade on Saturday, June 14, 2025, from 8:00 am until 2:00 pm. During this time, some services may be unavailable.

On Thursday, August 27, 2026, from 1800 until 2200, DTI will be performing maintenance on the [HOST_1] server. This work is expected to improve the performance of the server and resolve some current issues. The maintenance window is expected to last approximately 4 hours, during which time the server will be unavailable. If you have any questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, June 3, 2026, from 0100 until 0500, DTI will be applying critical patches to the State Email servers. Email services will be unavailable during this period.

On Thursday, July 10, 2026, from 2200 until 0200 the following morning, DTI will be performing maintenance on the IRAS Production system. Users are advised to complete their work by 2145 to allow for a smooth transition. The maintenance will involve applying necessary patches and performing configuration changes to enhance system performance.

On Sunday, August 23, 2026, from 0600 until 1400, DTI will be conducting scheduled maintenance on the core network switches at the Dover Data Centre. This maintenance is essential for upgrading the firmware and applying security patches to ensure the network's stability and security. During this period, there may be intermittent connectivity issues for services reliant on these switches. Users are advised to plan their work accordingly. For more detailed information on the affected services, please refer to [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this maintenance, please contact the DTI Helpdesk at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, November 1, 2025, from 2:00 am to 4:00 am, DTI will patch databases for the DMV registration portal, making them unavailable. All transactions should be completed by 1:45 am.

On Saturday, December 9, 2025, from 0800 until 1600, DTI will be upgrading firmware on core network switches at the Dover data center, which will temporarily disrupt connectivity for systems on subnets managed by [HOST_1]. This maintenance is expected to impact file sharing services and internal VoIP systems. All users should save work frequently during this window to avoid data loss.

Good morning, On Friday, January 19, 2026, beginning at 6:00 pm and continuing until Saturday, January 20, 2026, at 8:00 am, DTI will perform critical maintenance on the State's financial reporting platform managed by [HOST_1]. This will include database migrations and system upgrades. During this 14-hour window, users will not be able to access budgeting tools, report generation, or interagency financial sharing modules. Please ensure all work is saved and transactions are completed prior to the start of this maintenance. If you have any questions or encounter issues during this period, contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, March 12, 2025, from 10:00 am until 12:00 pm, the DTI team will be performing maintenance on the [HOST_1] server.

The State of Delaware Department of Finance will be performing maintenance on the IRAS Production system on Sunday, January 4, 2026, from 6:00 am until 10:00 am. All end users should be out of the application by 5:45 am.

On Thursday, May 28, 2026, from 1800 until 0600 the following morning, DTI will be performing maintenance to the DTI-managed Windows Production servers. To see the services impacted by this event, please click on the following link: [URL_1]. The maintenance involves upgrading the servers to the latest version of Windows. If you have any questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, March 20, 2025, from 2200 until 0600, DTI will be applying patches to the DOF email servers. Email services will be unavailable during this period.

On Friday, April 12, 2025, from 1700 until 2000, DTI will be performing maintenance on the State Revenue Online (SRO) system. Users may experience intermittent access during this time. For more information, visit [URL_1].

On Sunday, May 5, 2025, from 0600 until 1400, DTI will be conducting maintenance on the core network infrastructure. This work includes upgrading firmware on critical network devices and reconfiguring certain network segments. During this maintenance window, there may be periods of network instability or outages. All users are advised to complete their work by 0545 and to avoid logging in until 1430. For detailed information on the impacted services, please refer to [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the DTI Helpdesk at [EMAIL_1].
On Friday, March 10, 2025, from 2200 until 0400, DTI will patch [HOST_1] and [HOST_2]. Expect intermittent unavailability during this window.

Beginning at 6:00 am on Saturday, November 5, 2025, the Delaware Helper Payment Portal will undergo a planned database migration. The system will be fully unavailable for up to 5 hours during the upgrade, and users may experience temporary service interruptions until 1200.

On Sunday, December 13, 2026, DTI will be performing a firmware upgrade to the core network routers in the Dover data center. This maintenance will begin at 2:00 am and is expected to last until 10:00 am. During this window, brief network outages of up to 5 minutes at a time may occur for users connected to the Dover infrastructure. All business-critical systems will remain accessible, but some non-essential network resources may experience interruptions. If you have any questions or encounter service disruptions, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].

On Saturday, March 8, 2025, from 2200 until 0200, DTI will be applying firmware updates to the core network switches at the Carvel State Office Building. Network connectivity may be intermittent during this window.

Good morning, on Wednesday, June 11, 2025, from 1800 until 2100, DTI will be performing a scheduled upgrade to the Citrix NetScaler load balancers supporting the DOF Revenue Administration portal. Users may experience brief disconnections during the maintenance window. No action is required prior to the maintenance, but please save any open work before 1800.

On Sunday, August 17, 2025, beginning at 6:00 am and continuing until approximately 2:00 pm, DTI will be conducting a planned migration of the FSF PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM) Production database to new Oracle Exadata hardware located at the DTI Smyrna Data Center.

During this maintenance window, PeopleSoft HCM Production, including Employee Self-Service and Manager Self-Service, will be completely unavailable. The PeopleSoft Finance and Supply Chain environments are NOT affected by this work.

All end users should log out of PeopleSoft HCM no later than 5:45 am to avoid data loss. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this scheduled migration, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or [URL_1].

Good morning, DTI will be performing a scheduled upgrade to the Delaware Employee Health Benefits portal (DEHB) on Sunday, February 16, 2025, from 0600 until 1200. During this time, the portal will be unavailable to all users. Please plan accordingly and complete any pending enrollments or changes prior to the maintenance window. Contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] with questions.

On Wednesday, June 4, 2025, from 1800 until Thursday, June 5, 2025, at 0600, DTI will be performing a planned migration of the DOF Revenue Administration system (REVA) to new infrastructure hosted at the DTI Biddles Lane Data Center. During this maintenance window, all REVA modules—including tax processing, account lookup, and correspondence generation—will be completely unavailable.

End users should save all work and log out of REVA no later than 1745 on Wednesday evening. Any batch jobs scheduled after 1800 will be held and resubmitted once the migration is verified.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this maintenance, please contact the DOF Help Desk at [EMAIL_1] or the DTI Service Desk at [URL_1].
On Thursday, March 21, 2025, from 0200 until 0400, the Delaware Data Centre will be undergoing power maintenance, resulting in temporary unavailability.

On Tuesday, April 15, 2025, from 1630 until 1700, DTI will be applying patches to the DTI SFTP servers. As a result, DTI SFTP services will be unavailable while this work is being performed. For a list of impacted services, please visit [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, June 4, 2025 from 2200 to 2230, DTI will patch the HRMS production server.

The EZ-Pay vendor platform will undergo scheduled maintenance on Thursday, March 27, 2025, from 0600 until 0900. This upgrade will render the system unavailable to all external agency partners throughout this window.

The DOF Data Centre will perform maintenance on the core network switches on Saturday, January 18, 2025, beginning at 0700 and concluding at approximately 1300. This work is required to upgrade firmware across three switches supporting the Finance network fabric. During this period, intermittent network disruptions may affect connectivity to DOF applications and shared drives. Users should save work frequently before the maintenance window begins.

Please review the impacted services list at [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or [PHONE_1].
On Monday, July 1, 2025, from 0100 until 0500, DTI will be performing maintenance on the Finance Department's SQL servers.

On Wednesday, August 12, 2025, from 2200 until 0200 the following morning, DTI will be applying patches to the Revenue Management System. Users are advised to complete their work by 2145 to allow for a smooth transition. For more details, please visit [URL_1].

Good morning,
On Sunday, September 27, 2025, from 0600 until 1200, DTI will be performing maintenance on the core network switches at the Wilmington data center. This maintenance is necessary to upgrade the firmware and apply security patches. During this period, there may be intermittent connectivity issues. All users are requested to plan their work accordingly. For any questions or concerns, please contact the DTI Helpdesk at [EMAIL_1]. Thank you for your cooperation.
On Tuesday, December 5, 2025, from 0200 until 0400, DTI will perform maintenance on [HOST_1]. The server will be unavailable during this window.

The Delaware One Stop auditing platform will undergo scheduled maintenance on Thursday, March 2, 2026, from 9:00 pm until 1:00 am. The system will be inaccessible during this time while DTI applies database updates and security patches. Please log out by 8:45 pm to ensure no data loss occurs.

On Monday, July 17, 2026, from 6:00 am until 4:00 pm, DTI will be performing a major firmware upgrade on the core network switches located at the Elsmere Data Center. This maintenance is expected to impact network connectivity for several systems, including [HOST_1] and all devices configured to use IP range [IP_1]. To minimize disruptions, please ensure all users are logged out of affected systems by 5:45 am. For a full list of impacted services and updates during the maintenance window, please visit [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this scheduled maintenance, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, March 13, 2024, from 0200 until 0400, the DTI data centre in Dover underwent a successful power upgrade. The work is now complete.

The scheduled maintenance on the DTI-managed Windows servers at [HOST_1] has been completed. The work was performed on Tuesday, April 16, 2024, from 1800 until 2200, and the servers are now back online.

On Thursday, May 2, 2024, from 0900 until 1300, DTI performed a hardware upgrade on the core routers at [IP_1]. The upgrade was successful and the routers are now functioning as expected. The network team monitored the systems during and after the upgrade, and no issues were reported. If you have any questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI network team at [EMAIL_1].

UPDATE: The Palo Alto firewall maintenance originally scheduled for Saturday, March 8, 2025, has been extended. DTI now expects work to complete by 0800 Sunday morning. No additional outages are anticipated.

UPDATE: On Wednesday, June 11, 2025, from 2000 until 2359, DTI will be performing the previously announced Oracle database upgrade on the FSF Production environment. The maintenance window has been moved back one hour from the original schedule. Revenue and Accounting users should save all work and exit FSF by 1945. If you have questions, please contact the DOF Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].

Good morning,

This is an update regarding the planned SAP SuccessFactors platform maintenance communicated on Friday, April 4, 2025. The vendor has confirmed that the upgrade will now take place on Saturday, April 12, 2025, from 0100 until 0700, rather than the previously scheduled window of April 5.

During this time, all SuccessFactors modules—including Employee Central, Time Management, and Recruiting—will be unavailable to State of Delaware end users. No action is required ahead of the maintenance, but users should be aware that any in-progress sessions will be terminated at 0100.

If you have any questions or concerns about this revised schedule, please contact DTI Customer Care at [EMAIL_1] or [URL_1].
The maintenance on the DTI-managed SQL servers completed successfully on Thursday, May 15, 2025, at 1700.
The scheduled maintenance on the FirstMap 2.0 ArcGIS system concluded on Tuesday, January 14, 2025, at 1700. During this period, the system was unavailable for patching and configuration updates.

The planned maintenance on the core network switches, which began on Monday, February 3, 2025, at 0900, has been successfully completed by 1700 on the same day. This maintenance involved applying critical security patches and configuration changes to enhance network stability and security. Users may have experienced temporary connectivity issues during the maintenance window. For any questions or concerns, please contact the DTI helpdesk at [EMAIL_1].
The scheduled patching of the DOF Revenue Administration servers on Saturday, March 8, 2025, has been completed. All services have been restored and are operating normally.

Good morning, the planned firmware upgrade to the core network switches at the Carvel State Office Building, originally scheduled from 2200 on Friday, June 13, 2025, until 0200 Saturday, has been completed successfully. All network connectivity has been restored and is functioning as expected. No further action is required.

On Sunday, February 16, 2025, from 0600 until 1200, DTI performed scheduled maintenance on the vendor-hosted PeopleSoft Financial Management platform, including the application of quarterly security patches and database configuration changes.

This work has been completed as of 11:42 am. All modules—General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, and Asset Management—have been validated and are available for normal use. Users who experience any residual session issues should clear their browser cache and log in again.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this completed maintenance, please contact the DOF Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or call [URL_1].
On Sunday, March 2, 2025, from 02:00 until 04:00 AM, DTI will patch [HOST_1]. The system will be unavailable during this window.

On Wednesday, July 16, 2025, from 9 pm until 11 pm, DTI will perform maintenance on the Department of Finance's core network switches at [HOST_1]. During this time, brief network interruptions may occur, impacting connectivity for users across the Department.

On Saturday, November 15, 2025, from 6:00 AM until 2:00 PM, the Delaware Health and Social Services data center will undergo a planned power system upgrade. This maintenance is expected to cause a full outage of services hosted in the data center, including [HOST_1] and associated applications. During this window, users may experience intermittent disruptions to critical systems. While the maintenance is anticipated to last until 2:00 PM, services will be brought online as soon as work is completed. If you have questions or concerns, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, March 13, 2025, from 1400 until 1500, a mandatory security action will be taken on [HOST_1] to address a known vulnerability.

On Monday, June 15, 2025, from 10:00 am until 12:00 pm, DTI will be performing a scheduled security audit on the Delaware Financial Management System (DFMS) to identify potential security threats. The audit will involve reviewing system logs and monitoring network traffic.

On Friday, August 21, 2025, from 8:00 pm until 10:00 pm, DTI will be implementing a security patch to address a critical vulnerability in the State of Delaware's email system. This patch is a response to a recent phishing campaign targeting state employees. Users may experience brief interruptions to email services during this time. If you have any questions or concerns about this scheduled maintenance, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].
CRITICAL: Emergency security update to be applied to all workstations starting at 1800 on Friday, October 31, 2025.

On Wednesday, November 1, 2025, from 1000 until 1400, DTI will be deploying an emergency patch to address a critical vulnerability in the state's email system. All users are required to log out of their email accounts during this period. For more information, please visit [URL_1].

Effective immediately, the Department of Finance (DOF) is implementing a mandatory security action due to a detected phishing campaign targeting state employees. Starting Monday, December 1, 2025, at 0800, all users must change their passwords and enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) on their accounts. This action is crucial to protect sensitive information and prevent unauthorized access. Detailed instructions on how to change your password and set up MFA can be found at [URL_1]. If you encounter any issues during this process, please contact the DOF Help Desk at [EMAIL_1]. Your cooperation is essential to ensure the security of our systems.

On Friday, March 21, 2025, at 1300, DTI will perform emergency patching for a critical vulnerability on all state-issued Windows laptops. All users must reboot their devices by 1400 to apply the update.

On Wednesday, July 10, 2025, the Office of Management and Budget will conduct a mandatory password reset for all employees due to a recent phishing attempt. All users must update their credentials before 5:00 PM. Further instructions will be sent to [EMAIL_1].

Beginning Tuesday, November 5, 2025, at 8:00 AM, the Department of Technology and Information (DTI) will implement enhanced security measures in response to suspicious network activity detected on [HOST_1]. This activity includes multiple unauthorized login attempts to restricted systems. As part of this process, all users will be required to change their passwords and updating their multi-factor authentication settings. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this security advisory, please contact the DTI Service Desk at extension [IP_1].

On Friday, June 13, 2025, from 2000 until 2200, DTI will be performing a scheduled forced password reset for all accounts flagged during the recent credential compromise investigation. Users will be prompted to create new passwords at next login.

Good morning, DTI Security has identified a phishing campaign targeting State of Delaware employees using spoofed DocuSign links. Beginning Monday, March 10, 2025, at 0800, DTI will deploy updated email filtering rules to quarantine messages matching the known indicators of compromise. Users may experience a brief delay in email delivery during the rollout window, which is expected to conclude by 1200. If you receive a suspicious DocuSign email, do not click any links and forward it to [EMAIL_1].

On Wednesday, August 6, 2025, from 1800 until 2300, DTI will be applying an emergency security patch to the Apache Struts framework on all DTI-managed application servers in response to CVE-2025-31847, which is being actively exploited in the wild. This patch has been classified as critical by CISA and must be deployed within the mandated 48-hour remediation window.

During this maintenance, applications hosted on [HOST_1] and [HOST_2] will be intermittently unavailable as servers are restarted in rolling fashion. A full list of impacted services is available at [URL_1].

All agency application owners are advised to notify their end users of potential disruptions. If you have questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI Security Operations Center at [EMAIL_1] or call [PHONE_1].
The FirstMap 2.0 TEST ArcGIS system patching completed successfully on January 14, 2025. Service is restored.
On Tuesday, April 15, 2025, DTI completed scheduled patching of the DTI SFTP servers. All services have been restored and are operating normally. No further action is required at this time.

DTI has completed the planned maintenance on the DTI-managed Windows Production servers that was performed on Thursday, May 28, 2026, from 1800 until 0600 the following morning. All affected systems have been returned to service. Any intermittent connectivity issues reported during this window should now be resolved. If you experience any ongoing problems or have questions about this maintenance, please contact the DTI Service Desk via email at [EMAIL_1] or by calling the main support line. We apologize for any inconvenience this work may have caused and appreciate your patience throughout the maintenance window.
On Friday, March 7, 2025 from 2300 to 0200, DTI will patch the [HOST_7] email servers. DTI email services will be unavailable during this window.

On Thursday, November 14, 2025 from 0600 until 0800, the Delaware Online Tax Payment portal will be unavailable for scheduled maintenance. Users should complete all payment transactions prior to 0550. This outage is necessary to apply security updates to the application.

On Saturday, August 16, 2025 from 2100 until 0400 Sunday morning, DTI will be performing required maintenance on the [HOST_12] network infrastructure at the Dover data center. During this work, network connectivity may be intermittent for systems housed in that facility. Affected applications include the Core Financial System and related reporting tools. All users should save work frequently and log off by 2045. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this scheduled maintenance, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_5] or [PHONE_1].
UPDATED: DTI will patch the core routers Saturday, March 1, 2025, 0200-0400. Expect brief network interruptions.

UPDATED: The Delaware Financial Management System (DFMS) will undergo a database migration on Thursday, July 10, 2025, from 6:00 pm until 11:00 pm. Users will be unable to access DFMS during this window; please save your work and log out by 5:45 pm.

UPDATED: On Wednesday, October 15, 2025, from 1900 until 0200 the following morning, DTI will be performing a virtualization platform upgrade affecting multiple production workloads. The maintenance will impact the vendor-hosted application environment, including [URL_1] and related services. All end users should exit affected applications by 6:45 pm to prevent data loss. 

During this window, services may become intermittently unavailable or experience degraded performance. A complete list of impacted systems is available at [URL_2]. DTI technical staff will monitor the event throughout. 

If you have questions or concerns about this maintenance, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or call 302-555-0100.
Active phishing campaign targeting state employees detected. Report suspicious emails to [EMAIL_1].

An active security incident has been identified on the Delaware Financial Management System (DFMS). The incident involves unauthorized access to sensitive data. Immediate action is required to mitigate the issue.

A security advisory has been issued for the DTI-managed Windows servers. A vulnerability has been detected that could allow unauthorized access to sensitive data. Immediate action is required to apply the necessary patches to mitigate the issue. The list of affected servers can be found at [URL_1]. For further assistance, please contact the DTI security team at [EMAIL_1].
CRITICAL: Suspicious activity detected on [HOST_1]. Please review your account activity immediately.
CRITICAL: Compromised credentials have been identified within the DOF network. All users are required to change their passwords immediately. For assistance, contact the DOF Help Desk at [EMAIL_1].

CRITICAL: An emergency patch for an exploited vulnerability in the Windows Production servers will be applied on Thursday, May 28, 2026, from 1800 until 0600 the following morning. During this time, services may be intermittently unavailable. Please ensure all work is saved and applications are closed before the maintenance window. For more information on the services impacted, please visit [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns, contact the DTI Help Desk at [EMAIL_1].
Effective immediately, all State of Delaware employees must reset their email passwords due to a suspected phishing campaign targeting state accounts. Instructions available at [URL_1].

Good morning, DTI has detected unauthorized access attempts on several DOF file servers. As a precaution, all users are advised to disconnect from [HOST_1] and await further instructions. DOF security personnel are actively investigating the incident.

On Friday, September 22, 2025, DTI identified a potential security breach involving unauthorized access to the Department of Finance's VPN network. The incident is being actively investigated by the DTI Security Team. At this time, all VPN access has been temporarily suspended until the breach is contained. Users are advised to avoid connecting to [HOST_1] until further notice is provided. If you have any information related to this incident or concerns about your account security, please contact [EMAIL_1]. Additional updates will be provided as the investigation progresses.
A phishing campaign targeting state employees is active. Do not click links or download attachments from suspicious sender addresses.

Suspicious login activity has been detected on the DOF network around [IP_1]. All users must immediately verify their recent access logs and report any unrecognized sessions to the security team. If you believe your credentials have been impacted, change your password now through the self-service portal.

DTI has identified active exploitation of a critical vulnerability affecting several Windows Production servers. Emergency patching is now underway on impacted systems, including [HOST_1] and [HOST_2]. During this remediation, you may experience intermittent connectivity or brief service disruptions. All critical patches should be applied by end of day today. If you observe unusual behavior such as unexpected reboots or slow performance, please note the time and system affected. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this security incident, please contact the DTI Security Operations Center at [EMAIL_1] or via the IT Service Desk portal at [URL_1].
Update to Security Incident: suspicious activity detected on [HOST_1]. Further investigation is ongoing.

Update to Security Advisory: a phishing campaign targeting state employees has been identified. Employees are advised to be cautious with emails from unknown senders and report any suspicious activity to [EMAIL_1].

Update to Security Incident: a vulnerability was discovered in the DTI-managed Windows Production servers. Immediate action is required to apply the emergency patch available at [URL_1]. Please contact the DTI at [EMAIL_1] if you have any questions or concerns about this update. The patch will be applied during the scheduled maintenance window on Sunday, March 15, 2025, from 0200 until 0400. Employees are advised to save their work and log off by 0145 to avoid any disruption.
Compromised credentials detected. Reset your password immediately.
A recent phishing campaign has targeted our email system. Be cautious of suspicious emails and verify the sender's identity before responding. For more information, visit [URL_1].

An emergency patch has been released for a critical vulnerability that is being actively exploited. All users must install the patch by Friday, July 25, 2025. Failure to comply may result in restricted access to the network. For assistance, contact the IT Security team at [EMAIL_1]. Detailed instructions on applying the patch can be found at [URL_1]. This action is mandatory to ensure the security of our systems.

DTI has identified an active phishing campaign targeting State of Delaware employees with fraudulent DocuSign links. Do not click any unexpected DocuSign emails — report them immediately to [EMAIL_1].

Good morning, DOF Security has detected suspicious login activity on the IRAS Production environment originating from unauthorized IP addresses. As a precaution, all IRAS users are required to reset their passwords immediately via [URL_1]. Do not reuse your previous password. If you believe your account has been compromised, contact the DOF Information Security team at [EMAIL_1].

On Wednesday, March 12, 2025, DTI Security Operations identified that a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2025-21338) is being actively exploited against Microsoft Exchange servers. DTI-managed Exchange environments, including [HOST_1] and [HOST_2], are confirmed affected.

All agencies must apply the emergency patch released by Microsoft as of today. DTI will be force-deploying the patch to managed servers beginning at 2100 tonight; however, any agency-managed Exchange instances must be patched manually and immediately. Unpatched servers will be isolated from the state network without further notice.

If you manage an Exchange instance or have questions about whether your environment is affected, contact DTI Security Operations at [EMAIL_1] or call [URL_1] for the current status page.
On Friday, January 16, 2026, from 2300 until 2330, all DOF staff must change their network passwords in response to a confirmed phishing incident.

DTI will be deploying emergency security patches to the FirstMap production environment on Wednesday, February 19, 2026, from 1800 until 2000. This work addresses a critical vulnerability. The system will be unavailable during this window.

On Thursday, March 12, 2026, beginning at 0600 and concluding by 0800, DTI will be performing a scheduled credential reset for all privileged accounts on the DOF financial systems. This is a mandatory security measure following detection of unauthorized access attempts. Users must be logged off before 0545 to avoid being disconnected while work is in progress. Affected applications include the Financial Management System and the Enterprise Budget Portal. Please contact the DOF Security Office at [EMAIL_1] with any questions regarding this action or to report issues after completion.
Security incident on [HOST_1] resolved. Investigation complete.
A security advisory was issued for the DTI-managed Windows Production servers due to a phishing campaign. The issue has been resolved and servers are now secure.

A security incident was detected on the IRAS Production system on Tuesday, January 14, 2025, at 0900. The system was immediately isolated and investigated. The issue was resolved by applying an emergency patch to the exploited vulnerability. The system is now back online and secure. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the DOF at [EMAIL_1].
Updated: Phishing email recently detected targeting State employees. Do NOT click links from unverified sources. Report to [EMAIL_1].

Updated: Recent suspicious login activity detected on the DOF VPN service. As a precaution, all users must reset their credentials by end of day via [URL_1]. This is mandatory to maintain secure access.

Updated: A critical security vulnerability has been identified in the State’s HRMS payroll system. Emergency patching will occur on Sunday, March 9, 2025, from 2:00 AM to 5:00 AM. During this time, access to the HRMS will be restricted. All users must log out by 1:45 AM to ensure successful application of the patch. This vulnerability has the potential to expose sensitive employee data, and immediate action is required. If you have any questions or concerns about this incident, please contact the DTI security team at [EMAIL_1].
UPDATED: Suspicious login activity detected on [HOST_1]. Account passwords expired immediately across DOF domain.

UPDATED: A phishing campaign targeting state employees has been identified through messages appearing to originate from [EMAIL_1]. Please delete these messages without clicking any links. DOF IT is actively filtering inbound mail to block this pattern. Verify unexpected financial requests by phone before taking action.

UPDATED: DTI has detected attempts to exploit a critical vulnerability in the external-facing web services hosted on [HOST_2]. Emergency patches are being applied to resolve this exposure. The affected portal will undergo an unscheduled maintenance window from Friday, February 7, 2026 starting at 1800 until 2200. Users may experience intermittent availability during this period. All session data will be cleared as a precautionary measure and you will be required to re-establish connections after the maintenance completes. If you observe any further unusual behavior or have questions about this incident, please contact the DTI Security Operations Center at [EMAIL_2] or call the DOF IT Service Desk.
The suspected phishing email campaign has been fully contained. No further action is required.

Emergency security patching for exploited Exchange vulnerabilities is now complete. All impacted systems have been restored and verified. Thank you for your patience during this mandatory remediation.

On Wednesday, March 12, 2025, a security incident involving compromised credentials was reported on the DOF HR Portal. Immediate forensic action was taken, affected accounts were locked, and passwords were forcibly reset. The investigation confirmed that no sensitive employee data was exfiltrated, and system integrity has been restored. All impacted users have been notified via separate email to re-establish access. If you experience any ongoing issues or have questions about this incident, please contact the DOF Security Office at [EMAIL_1] for assistance.
Security incident on [HOST_1] resolved on February 1, 2025. No further action required.

On January 30, 2025, a phishing campaign targeting DOF employees was detected and neutralized. All suspicious emails have been deleted from inboxes. If you received a phishing email, please report it to [EMAIL_1].

On January 28, 2025, DTI identified and resolved a security incident involving compromised credentials on the Finance Application Server. The incident was detected through automated monitoring systems, and immediate action was taken to secure the affected accounts. All compromised credentials have been reset, and additional security measures have been implemented to prevent future incidents. If you experience any issues logging in, please contact the DTI Helpdesk at [EMAIL_1]. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your cooperation in maintaining the security of our systems.
The potential security concern with unusual logins on the DOF Public Portal reported on Monday, October 9, 2023, has been resolved. Regular operations have resumed without further incident.

The phishing attempt impacting [EMAIL_1] and targeting DTI staff on Friday, November 3, 2023, has been fully addressed. All compromised accounts have been resecured, and the source of the attempt has been identified and mitigated as of 16:45. No further action is necessary from staff at this time.

On Saturday, December 9, 2023, a suspicious activity alert was triggered on [HOST_1], a server managed by DTI that supports the State’s financial reporting systems.
